profile.headline: Software Engineer at Bloomberg LP
profile.geoLocationName: Queens County, New York, United States
profile.summary:
IT Professional with extensive experience in computer related solutions ranging from mainframe and "minicomputer" to latest web based technologies. Experienced in telecommunication hardware control systems, robotics, administrative systems and more recently finance, compliance and regulatory systems. International experience (Mexico, Italy, France and United States). Experience in several SQL dialects (Sybase, Oracle, MS SQL Server, Image and PC languages.

Fluent in Spanish, Italian, French and English, with some understanding of Portuguese, Romanian and German. Good communication skills.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: C, C++, Visual C#, Slang (GS scripting language), COBOL, Angular, Java, JavaScript, Perl, XML
Databases: MS SQL Server, Sybase and Sybase IQ, Oracle, HP Transact/3000, SecDB (GS own OODb)
Operating Systems: Linux, Sun Solaris, HP-UX, Windows 3.x to Server 2012, DEC-VMS, IBM-MVS, HP/3000
Telecom: SDH, PDH and some SONET protocols
System Life Cycles: SDLC
Version Management: CVS, SourceForge, SVN

email: marq8504@yahoo.com

positions.title: VP and Senior Developer at GS Merchant Banking
positions.description: Managed and participated in several projects to increase the efficiency of several Merchant Banking, compliance and regulatory activities. ETL and data warehouse projects; Volcker related projects; SDR (Swap Dealer Regulatory Reporting) project; automation of Form PF reporting; UK’s Retail Distribution Review (RDR) implementation; Migration Visual Studio applications from Team Foundation Server (TFS) platform to the Goldman Sachs’ SDLC (Conductor, SourceForge, SVN, etc) platform, also known as CSF

positions.title: VP and Senior Developer at GS Commodities Trade Processing IT
positions.description: Senior Developer overseeing and participating specifically in Commodities trading applications; Physical Infrastructure Project to increase the volume and complexity of the Commodities trading

positions.title: Commodities Trading Tech
positions.description: Development and Support of legacy Commodities systems such as Energy OPS, COS, etc. (from 2000 to 2001 worked as consultant for The Laxmi Group)

positions.title: Scientific Software Engineer
positions.description:
Hardware-intensive automated semiconductor measurement software design and implementation. Development of programs to perform the mathematical and statistical analysis of silicon wafers and the interfaces with the specific robotic hardware


(as a consultant for The Laxmi Group)

positions.title: Senior Telecommunications Software Engineer
positions.description: Participation in control systems to reroute telecomm circuits for Add-Drop Multiplexers (ADMs) and large bandwidths (STM-1, 4, 8 & 16); Element Management Layer (1353SH) and Network Management Layer (1354RM) software.

positions.title: Latin America Senior Technical Support
positions.description: Project leader, installation and start-up of a national network of 10 1644SX multiplexors in Mexico; Y2K certification project in Mexico, several software and hardware systems involved

positions.title: Telecommunications Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Vimercate, Italia (15 miles/25 Klm outside Milan)
positions.description: Participation on the 1354RM – Network Management Layer (NML) – software to automate the national recovery of a 1644SX mesh network
